fields.after: Owner decisions (A8, 2026-11-20): explicit root part container; the grip part is drag-handle (4 legacy records said gripper and moved to the new part name, legacy output unchanged). Figma S2 Web Bar panel and toolbar (9952:19120): Drag handle, action buttons, Divider, Slot. Style (primary, secondary), density (5 widths 44 to 72) and the floating shadow are options and styling, not parts; the legacy widths 40/56/72 do not match the Figma densities (gap bead). The registry entry wrongly called this a sub-part shared by color area and color wheel; fixed.
